episodes.title: Fill or Kill
episodes.summary: A group of master thieves break into Lochmill Capital and hold Zara and her colleagues at gunpoint, attempting the heist of the century.

episodes.title: Face Value
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the heist, Zara finds herself under intense pressure as Luke breaks down. DCI Covaci meets unexpected resistance on the investigation.

episodes.title: Short Run
episodes.summary: A flashback shows more of Zara and Luke's lives pre-heist. Present day, Zara finds herself in a high-stakes situation. Running out of options, she makes a risky choice.

episodes.title: Risk On
episodes.summary: Zara makes a dangerous alliance to uncover the truth about the heist. A revelation about the missing Lochmill money puts Rhys in conflict with powerful figures.

episodes.title: Pay Yourself First
episodes.summary: Zara is given a life-changing ultimatum. With her survival on the line, who can she really trust?

episodes.title: Dead Cat Bounce
episodes.summary: An action-packed final showdown at Lochmill Capital has devastating consequences. In a shocking reveal, all truths about the heist come to light.
